 Tampa Bay spared the worst of Florida’s rain. What to expect this week
 In some parts of the state, an astonishing 17 inches of rain fell in two days. Share . Floodwaters rushed around parked cars in Miami Beach as a low-pressure system made its way toward Florida. Tampa Bay has been spared the worst of Florida's torrential rains. [ PEDRO PORTAL | TNS ] Michaela Mulligan is a climate and environment reporter. Reach her at mmulligan@tampabay.com.
